previous_last_sync.summary: Human-reviewed manual recovery audit for actuator inhibition across blocking burns. Source evidence is pinned at [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md); no new user setting or workflow requires a guide. The ledger limits the integration merge to the audited original.

decisions.rationale: Latches ETB and DC outputs off during blocking flash I/O until fresh feedback and a new control cycle; it changes safety behavior without a new user setting.
evidence: [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md): Blocking calibration burns inhibit electronic-throttle and DC wastegate outputs until fresh feedback and a new valid cycle.

[firmware/controllers/actuators/electronic_throttle.cpp](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/actuators/electronic_throttle.cpp): Burn gating stops configured ETB control and resumes only after newer valid sensor updates.

[firmware/controllers/sensors/core/sensor.h](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/sensors/core/sensor.h): Sensor timestamps carry freshness through stored, redundant and proxy providers.

last_sync.summary: Human-reviewed manual recovery audit for failed-start stopped transition. Source evidence is pinned at [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md); no new user setting or workflow requires a guide. decisions.rationale: Completes the stopped transition after a start that never reaches positive RPM; it corrects internal trigger cleanup without adding user configuration.
evidence: [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md): Failed starts that never report positive RPM complete the stopped transition after trigger timeout.

[firmware/controllers/algo/engine.cpp](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/algo/engine.cpp): Zero-RPM SPINNING_UP is treated as an active start and checked/reset under one critical section.
